title: Advancing Legal Reasoning: The Integration of AI to Navigate Complexities and Biases in Global Jurisprudence with Semi-Automated Arbitration Processes (SAAPs)
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates the evaluation of morals and ethics into its core research design, utilizing Jonathan Haidt's Moral Foundations Theory to examine moral opinions and the Hague Rules on Business and Human Rights Arbitration to adjudicate ethical corporate conduct and justice.
